Although the roles of replicative Pol α and Pol δ in chromosomal DNA replication are relatively well understood and well documented, the precise role of Pol ε in chromosomal DNA replication is not well understood. This study uses a Xenopus egg extract DNA replication system to further elucidate the replicative role(s) played by Pol ε.
